text: In a plaintext autokey the message keys itself, so the known words reach along chains of letters L apart. A wrongly carved letter breaks a chain; losing one's place shifts every letter after it.

Every lag 1-52 on 35,343 tables, allowing 2 broken links anywhere or one lost step at any place; at lags 26-29 every table's reading scored; the best read blind by the judge with 20 scrambled copies', and three planted slipped messages.
Nothing fits K4 below lag 24 (copies from 17); K4's best reading scores 4, the copies' 12; the plants, one with a slip running on through its chain, are found.
